text: Impaired visuospatial working memory (WM) often negatively impacts the quality of life of patients with Parkinson’s Disease (PD). The Block Span Task (BST) is a novel Corsi-Block-like task adapted for use in functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanner to understand the neurophysiological mechanisms underlying visuospatial impairment in PD. This pilot study examines whether the BST is a practical tool to provide an in-scanner visuospatial WM task for older adults with mild–moderate PD.
source_label: Visuospatial cognition in people with Parkinson’s disease: a pilot study assessing a block span task using fMRI
